document: Remove Knighthood of Geoffrey Cox, remove the Knighthood of Geoffrey Cox in view of his recent parliamentary activities in 2021, the award is not compitable with similar Knighthoods.

Hold a public inquiry into unfair business practices during the pandemic, We believe many businesses, families and individuals have been unfairly treated by lenders, lawyers & other businesses during the pandemic. The Government should launch a public inquiry to investigate evidence of unfair business practices during the pandemic, including bullying & harassment.

Fund graves for babies regardless of gestational age, If a baby dies before the 24th week of pregnancy and the parents choose to have a burial they are charged fees by local councils for the baby's grave. These fees vary widely from £150 to £1,000 plus.

Stop all schools detaining children after school in the winter months, For all schools to be banned from detaining pupils after school in the winter months and sending them home in the dark with no regard for their safety
Stop ministers from using a private jet for Government business , Government ministers should not use a private jet to conduct Government business. They should use everyday flights.

Lower family court fees, I feel that the price of the family court fees is extortionate and should be lowered to an affordable amount to allow more fathers and mothers to help gain access to their children.
Raise the salary band for sterile services technicians & supervisors in England., Increase the salary of NHS sterile services technicians and supervisors to a band 3 and 4.

Review medical care and treatment for babies with failure to thrive, My son Aiden was born with a heart condition that went undiagnosed for over four years. Despite being diagnosed with failure to thrive, his organs were not checked. I want to the Government to review medical care and treatment for babies with failure to thrive, to give them the best chance possible.

Require all police conduct complaints & appeals to be referred to the IOPC, The Government should amend the Police Reform Act 2002 to remove individual police forces’ right to investigate complaints and appeals against its own officers’ conduct. Such complaints and appeals should always be referred to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC).

Conduct an independent public inquiry into the Birmingham ‘Trojan Horse’ affair., Following the revelations in a podcast by journalists Hamza Syed and Brian Reed. The truth now needs to come out. Who was behind this hoax? Why did decision makers dismiss crucial evidence presented at every turn? We know who the victims of this hoax were, but who were the beneficiaries?

Require all GPs have a designated Mental Health Nurse, In 2019, 40% of GP appointments were related to Mental Health. The impact of the covid-19 pandemic has further highlighted the importance of mental health. Yet, many patients presenting with mental health issues are failed by their GP.

Legal requirement that all job adverts include rate of pay/salary, Make it a legal requirement that all and any job advertisements must list the rate of pay/salary for the job advertised. Not a range or estimate, a specific monetary amount.

Oral Function/Tongue Tie Training to be given to all Midwives & Health Visitors, Ensure all Health Visitors and Midwives within the NHS are given thorough tongue tie and oral function training to assess babies appropriately in the first few weeks of life.

Increase doctors pay with the rising costs of living, We want the pay to increase in line with the inflation rate. Every bill is increasing by 2-5% but the salaries remain unchanged, which is significantly affecting the quality of living

Ensure student nurses are paid for placement hours, The Government should require that student nurses be paid while on placement as part of their training. This should be at least the minimum wage for apprentices.
Increase statutory maternity pay for working mothers to 6 months at 90%, Increase the SMP to 6 months at 90% of salary for working mothers.
Ensure Trans people are fully protected under any conversion therapy ban, Ensure any ban fully includes trans people and all forms of conversion therapy.

Include Transgender and Non-Binary Identities in the Ban on Conversion Therapy., This petition demands that the government bans conversion therapy (CT) for gender identity as well as sexuality to protect anyone that has a gender identity different from that which they were assigned at birth (Transgender or Non-Binary (NB)) from the abuse and torture of the cruel practice.

Make it illegal to pierce the body of babies or children under the age of 11, I want the Government to make it illegal to pierce the ears of babies and children under the age of 11. That includes the possibility of arrest and prosecution of any individual, parent or business that executes the practice of piercing any body part of a baby or child under the aforementioned age.

Make Graduate visa extendable and count towards permanent residency, The Government should allow the newly introduced Graduate visa to be extendable and for holders of this visa to become eligible for permanent residency after 5 years.

Hold a public inquiry into "partygate" and how it has been investigated, To protect our democracy, we believe a full public inquiry needs to be held to establish the extent of wrongdoing, and also how allegations of illegal social gatherings in government buildings have been investigated, both within government and by the police.

Provide emergency medical equipment and medicines to Sri Lanka, Sri Lanka's top medical union has declared a national health emergency over a life-threatening shortage of drugs. The medical crisis has been declared as doctors and hospitals reported a widespread lack of medicine.

Make Prenatal Alienating a criminal offence in Scotland., There are to many fathers that are being denied appropriate access to children, and the mothers are aloud to brainwash the children into thinking fathers are bad perants, Scotland is so far behind the rest of the world on regards to this, its about time they caught up.

Hold a referendum on using the Additional Member System for General Elections, I would like the Government to hold a referendum, to give the British public the Chance to change the way we vote in UK general elections. The question should be whether we adopt an Additional Member System (AMS) such as the one used in Scottish and Welsh parliamentary elections.

Require Ministers found to break the law be removed from office and lose pension, Any Ministers of Government, including the Prime Minister found to be guilty of breaking any laws should be removed from ministerial office and Parliament, and stripped of any pension rights they accrued from ministerial office.

Investigate how to improve recruitment and retention in the social care sector, We want the Government to hold a review to investigate what can be done to improve recruitment and retention in the social care sector, which provides care for our vulnerable loved ones.

Make the Queens Platinum Jubilee a permanent Bank Holiday, Make June 3rd a permanent Bank Holiday every year. Since Queen Elizabeth II is the longest serving monarch it would be a wonderful way to remember her for years to come.

Change legal definition of stillborn to include all delivered babies, I want the government to change this SAD law that defines stillbirth as only applying to babies lost after 24 weeks. When a mother has to give birth to the child, this is a stillborn baby.

Give elderly and vulnerable adults legal rights to have hospital visitors, Though national Covid restrictions have been lifted, many hospitals are still denying patients visitors. Elderly and vulnerable adults in hospital often depend on friends and family to advocate for their care, support them, and help with eating/drinking. Give them legal rights to hospital visitors.

Make the role of Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) a standalone role, We are calling for the role of the DSL to become a standalone role in schools & colleges. It is unfeasible to think that this fundamental role in keeping children safe in education can be fulfilled as a bolt on to any other role, especially whilst maintaining a teaching timetable.

Stop paying Northern Irish politicians refusing to form our government., The members of stormont are refusing to form our government but are still being fully paid. Suspend all pay and expenses without chance of back pay.

Create a new body to review & oversee the Code of Conduct for MPs and sanctions, A new Independent Office of MPs Conduct should be created to review the existing Code of Conduct to ensure it's fit for purpose, on a par with that of other public bodies e.g. the Police, and be given powers to investigate and impose sanctions for alleged breaches of this revised Code of Conduct.

Stop salary and expenses to MLAs of parties who refuse to nominate ministers, For 2nd time, Northern Ireland (NI) has no government due to a refusal of a party to nominate ministers. In 2019, nearly £15 MILLION was spent on salaries while NI had no government. Should any party refuse to nominate ministers, their MLAs should have their pay and expenses completely removed.
Stop MLA's pay in Northern Ireland until the Executive is formed, Taxpayers face paying out more than £94,000 a week in wages to MLAs and ministers even if the Assembly is not sitting.

VOTES FOR 16 - Lower the voting age to 16, The voting age should be lowered to 16. We need a representation for the youth population and lowering the voting age to 16 will allow the young people to have their voice heard.

Conduct a review into the family court service CAFCAS, A review should be set up to look at the services and conduct of CAFCAS in family court cases. The review should result in recommendations for reforming the CAFCAS service to improve its work, ensure that decisions are evidence based and fully take into account the voices of children.

Scrap university tuition fees for Student Nurses and re-introduce full bursary., To support the careers of the future Nurses, Midwives and Paramedics. Drop the tuition fees for universities, and to re-introduce the full bursary, which includes living costs. Also to bring more mental health support for these pathways. Also to pay student nurses a wage.

To Reform The General Medical council's investigating process against doctors., The General Medical council's investigatory process should be made more transparent, simpler and with a proportionate response when comes to punishing doctors for trivial, non clinical and non patient related  issues.
Provide baby boxes for all newborn children in England, Fund provision of baby boxes to every new parent so that every baby gets the same start in life. These are currently rolled out in Scotland.

Reduce tax on fuel for domiciliary and community care nurses, The Government should reduce tax on fuel for domiciliary and community care workers. They provide a valued service within communities to those in need. weekly to fulfil their roles.
Automatically register fathers on birth certificates, Fathers should automatically be added to a child’s birth certificate from birth, so they are automatically granted parental responsibility.
Inquiry into Debendox and birth defects, and fund compensation, Parliament debated this drug in 1984 as it was thought to have caused birth defects.

Fund increase in police officers in line with population, The Government should fund an increase in police officer numbers nationally, in line with the increasing population. In London, for example, Metropolitan police numbers increased by 2.5% between 2012 and 2022, however the London population has increased by around 11% during that time.

Reduce or remove VAT from sales of Automated External Defibrillators (AED), Approximately, 30,000 cardiac arrests occur every year in the UK. If a defibrillator is used with effective CPR the chance of survival significantly increases.

My rights to be called Mother and grandmother, I want the rights to stop schools, hospitals , college , university to stop teaching that the words relating to being a mother father, grandmother, grandfather as being wrong .
I have rights to too be called what I am a mother .I don't like my children's  to refer to me as a birth parent .

Reduce amounts and rights to payments for Ministers leaving office, We, the undersigned, call on the Government to amend Section 4 of the Ministerial and other Pensions and Salaries Act 1991 in relation to "grants", which are paid to Ministers who leave office, whether they resign or are removed by the Prime Minister.

Suspend leaving payments for Ministers leaving office from July-September 2022, Severance payments of 25% salary are made when they resign or are sacked irrespective of the period they have been in office. We believe these payments should be suspended for any Ministers who leave office between July and September 2022.

Fund expedited treatment for babies born with tongue tie, Tongue-tie affects ~10% of babies and can prevent babies from feeding effectively. Tongue-tie division takes seconds however babies often wait weeks before being treated. Hospitals should be resourced to expedite tongue-tie division, reducing harm and costs associated with breastfeeding support.

Implement recommendations of the Mineworkers’ Pension Scheme report, We the undersigned call upon the Government to implement the recommendations of the BEIS Select Committee inquiry, and subsequent report, into the Mineworkers Pension Scheme.

Appoint an Adult Mental Health Ambassador and Adult Mental Health Group, Mental health and the lack of a joined up approach and timely services is a major issue.
 
The Government has appointed a Youth Mental Health Ambassador - so the importance and impact of such a role is already realised. We believe there should also be an Adult Mental Health Ambassador.

Inquiry into Ofgem to determine if it is fit for purpose, An urgent inquiry needs to happen into Ofgem to determine whether they are fit for purpose. This inquiry should consider whether Ofgem is fulfilling its roles and responsibilities as detailed on their About Us page on their website.
Suspend all taxes until the government start working for the Real people, Suspend all taxes until the government start working for the Real people
Suspend school uniform for 12 months, Require schools to temporarily suspend school uniform requirements until we are through the cost of living crisis

Fund free access to baby CPR training during pregnancy, Give mums access to free baby CPR training. Physical training should be provided for all expecting mothers, either at a routine midwife appointment or antenatal class.

Allow people to vote "for" or "against" parliamentary e-petitions, There is no count of the opposing view in the existing e-petition system. This can be used to dismiss any petition outcome, because the level of opposition is unknown. Allowing people who oppose a petition to vote against it could give petitions more weight and attract more democratic interest.

A statue of HM Queen Elizabeth II to be erected in Trafalgar square., A statue of Her Majesty should be commissioned and raised in this prominent place, if necessary by public subscription, as a permanent memorial to Her Majesty.

Place a permanent statue of Queen Elizabeth II on the 4th plinth of Trafalgar Sq, We ask the government of the day to pass a law that requires the 4th plinth in Trafalgar Square must have a permanent statue of her late majesty Queen Elizabeth II placed on it

Hold a referendum  on the monarchy, Hold a referendum on the monarchy to see what people's true feelings are on the monarchy. For many years we have had a monarchy in this country and we as citizens have never had a say in whether we want the monarchy or not.

But now as a new reign begins we should have a chance to have our say.

A Public Inquiry into excess deaths and austerity from 2012 to 2019, Set up a Public Inquiry into the estimated 330,000 excess deaths for 2012 to 2019 that research has found are largely attributable to austerity. This should be similar to the Covid-19 Inquiry into the 180,000 deaths in the UK of people who tested positive for Covid-19 during the Pandemic.
Seek to suspend Russia as a permanent member of the UN Security Council, The UK government should introduce a motion to have Russia removed as a permanent member of the UN Security Council.
Hold a public inquiry into the sale of Royal Mail, Hold a public inquiry into the undervalued sale of the Royal Mail.

Review payments and pensions paid to mps and ministers when leaving their roles., Stop all final payments to ministers and mps when they leave roles.  There should not be extortionate pay outs. Review politicians pensions to be based on length of service and salary. MPs to contribute to pensions and lose pension rights if Gross Misconduct or incompetent.

Start fracking immediately, Shale gas extraction through fracking should start immediately. To prevent a lot of misery and possible death through hyperthermia 
this winter with the elderly and low income
public.

Abolish grants paid to Ministers leaving office, Government ministers can claim a taxpayer-funded grant equal to 1/4 of their annual ministerial salary when they leave ministerial office, on top of their MP's salary of £82,000. Ministers should not be rewarded irrespective of how long or capably they have served

No more Conservative voted Prime Minster - We want a General Election., The Conservative party is about to elect again another Prime Minister with less than 1% of the population. This isn't democratic. We need a General Election.

Hold a vote on re-instating the fracking ban without whips involved, Fracking was deemed as dangerous and a risk to  the country. Truss held a vote (19/10/22), where MPs were told regardless of their actual views, they had to agree to approve fracking or they would lose the whip ie. be thrown out of the Conservative party.  Truss is gone. Let's hold an honest vote.

Require Prime Ministers serve for two years to claim Public Duty Costs Allowance, Introduce a qualifying period of two years for a Prime Minister to be able to claim the PDCA allowance on leaving the role. The two-year period to be halved for a party leader who has won a general election. Any Prime Minister found guilty of breaking the law whilst in office should not be eligible.

Abolish the bedroom tax, With the cost of living and rising prices I’m asking that the bedroom tax be abolished to help us Vulnerable . Disabled and the Elderly who have to pay this out when it would help us in this crisis. As it would be spare money to help towards our cost of heating our homes this winter.

After massive population growth, it's time to stop all immigration into the UK., Withdraw from ECHR and other multi-national conventions to permit the UK to stop all further immigration from all sources, then pass legislation forbidding all further immigration without exception.

Review the role, costs, pay and expenses of MPs and Ministers., Ministers’ pay should be cut by 5% and frozen.  Expenses limited to £100,000.  The working week starting from Monday am until Friday.  Any finances or outside interests should not conflict with their current role.  MPs renting out or owning London property and claiming rent costs elsewhere.

Hold Public Inquiry on the Safety of Mental Health Services for the vulnerable, For the sake of safeguarding Children & Vulnerable Adults in need of care. 

A National Inquiry on both Private Institutes & the NHS Mental Health Services for finding risk factors so that we can better assess how to ensure people are safe.

Make congenital heart disease scans available at birth, We would like all babies to be offered scans at birth for undetected congenital heart disease (CHD). 1000 babies leave UK hospitals each year with undetected CHD. Our Ronnie lived for 2 years seeing many doctors and having hospital admissions. There is not enough done.

Launch a Public Inquiry into the approval process for covid-19 vaccines, We want the Government to launch a Public Inquiry to investigate the MHRA's process for approving covid-19 vaccines.
 
This should consider all aspects of the approval process, including how approval was expedited and the drivers for expedition, and any potential conflicts of interests.

Investigate UK excess deaths not related to Covid., On the week ending the 28th of October the ONS reported excess deaths were 12.5% above the 5 year average. With only 717 deaths out of 12,861 involving Covid. This alarming excess death percentage, needs investigating by the Government and the root causes laid out in a public report.

Require councils to suspend rises in council tax during the financial crisis., Millions are worried about the future of their wages and financial security of their families. 
The Government should require councils to suspend any rises in council tax to help people who are struggling, by giving them the security that they need and not forcing them to pay more charges

Create a National Care Service, This country needs a sister service to the NHS to focus on social care 
Care of vulnerable and elderly citizens.

Giving social care a new and unique identity. This new service would take full control of social care, standardise all aspects of care 
create new and specialised national service

Review national guidelines for safety and security of taxi/ph drivers, The Government should conduct a review of the safety and security of taxi/ private hire to look at how lone drivers can be protected. They should consult drivers, industry leaders and stakeholders.

To reduce by 50% forthwith all ministerial salaries for a period of 2 years., To reduce by 50% forthwith all  ministerial salaries provided for under the Ministerial and Other Salaries Act 1975 for an initial period of 2 years as an emergency provision in light of the cost of living crisis. Ministers need to demonstrate their commitment to reducing the government deficit.

Introduce a 'Safe Haven' law for abandoned babies here in the UK, Create a baby box within public sectors to prevent any babies being “dumped” and to also protect the mothers who have given birth with the after care they may require.
Increase pay of nurses and teachers by the inflation rate., Nurses and teachers deserve a good pay increase. The government should be talking to their leaders and funding an agreement.

Increase wages of all dental nurses, Increase the wages in line with inflation, high cost of living generally. Many dental nurses have years of experience and aren’t recognised of their hard work at all. It is time this changed all nurses deserve minimum of £20/h
Regulate slimming companies , I would like to see anyone who approaches a company offering slimming techniques or diets to be required to seen in person by a qualified dietician or doctor first.

Give doctors and nurses the 20% pay rise they deserve, With current inflations and current problems in the current system; medical professionals deserve a pay rise.

Give them the 20% pay rise they need and deserve.
